verdict.rationale: For skills, the docs support both scopes. Teams can check skills into a working folder, and Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the current directory up to the repo root, which covers project-local, repo-committed use. `$skill-installer` adds skills to "your own local Codex setup", which implies user-level installs. For plugins themselves, installation goes through `/plugins` and configured marketplaces (tracked via `config.toml`), with no documented choice between project and global scope. Missing for 10: explicit project-vs-user install scope for plugins, documented user-global skill location, and hands-on corroboration.
